name: Data Encrypted for Impact
source: MITRE ATT&CK (vendored excerpt — not a live scrape)
summary: Adversaries encrypt files on target systems to interrupt availability. Common signals include rapid high-entropy writes, ransom notes, and known encryptor families. Isolation plus restore from a clean pre-infection backup is a standard containment pattern — domain controllers and other critical infrastructure must not be isolated automatically.
detection_hints: Known ransomware process or extension patterns
